ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-density concentration of low-intensity pixels (dark gray/black) with minimal high-intensity pixels visible on the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform dark pixel distribution across both lobes; absence of contiguous high-contrast mottling or light-colored geometric blobs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with a deep vertical depression dividing the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex distal edges sweeping upwards and outwards toward pointed, irregular tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of textured pixels localized at the lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and erosion at the distal tips of both lobes, creating a jagged and asymmetrical appearance at the boundaries.
